children: Kankanwadi Sudhindra, an officer serving as Deputy CFO & CAO, reported two direct sale transactions in Synopsys common stock. The total proceeds from the sales were $6,039,340. After the reported transactions, the reporter directly owns 22,717 shares of Synopsys common stock.
